message.content: {"question": "Two moles of ideal gas, initially in the state 1, are put in contact with a thermal reservoir at a temperature of T₁ = 400 K and reach through a isochoric irreversible transformation one thermodynamic state 2 (T₂ = 800 K). The specific heat of the gas at constant pressure depends on the temperature and can be written as Cₚ/R = 2 + 0.02T. Determine the heat Q₁₂ exchanged in this transformation.", "options": {"A": "Q₁₂ = 8.65 10² J", "B": "Q₁₂ = 200 J", "C": "Q₁₂ = 8.65 10³ J", "D": "Q₁₂ = 8.65 10⁴ J"}, "correct": null}
